meta.title: Turn Sieve (dsh-turn-sieve)
meta.description: Selectively drop a whole exchange, only your prompt, only the assistant reply, or a single message from the current conversation. Every chat row can be sieved in place: the assistant action row on the right, and a button that floats in from the left of your own messages. One click selects that part — it instantly gets a deeper background with rounded shadow corners — then confirm with ✓, cancel with ✕, and switch between “Exchange / Prompt / Reply / Only this”. No dialog at all. Stopped and failed turns can be sieved too; only while the agent is still running is the newest exchange locked. In-turn notice cards (stopped, turn failed, model request retried, context compaction, and the rest) can also be sieved one by one, and restored from the main panel. Once removed, the part disappears from the transcript immediately (the append-only log stays intact) and can be restored with one undo from the main panel. The main panel uses a bright liquid-glass look with “Liquid glass / Motion” toggles in its header. The system context and the initial session context stay protected. 0.7.0 also fixes a fatal bug present since 0.2.0: the sieve marker was written with turn/step 0 while DSH format v4 requires both to be positive, so every prune failed at the very first step and nothing was ever removed.
